title: Hilirisasi nikel: larangan ekspor bijih, kawasan industri Morowali dan Weda Bay, dan tata kelola risikonya
status_note: The policy chronology is from official sources: the ESDM export-ban release (2019), the WTO DS592 dispute page (2022), the ESDM Perpres 112/2022 release, the Setkab presidential statement (2023), BPS regional growth (2023 release) and Kemenperin estate articles (2014, 2017). The fatal accident is from ANTARA (state news agency). Deforestation and flooding concerns in Halmahera Tengah are from Mongabay journalism citing Auriga Nusantara data. They are labeled as reported concerns, not official measurements. Not 'validated': no regional production, employment, tax, pollution or health series was sourced.

regency_city_documented.evidence: Kemenperin (2014) reports the opening of the Morowali Tsingshan industrial estate (KIMT) as a gift for the 15th anniversary of Kabupaten Morowali. ANTARA and Kontan (Dec 2023) place the IMIP smelter explosion in Kabupaten Morowali.

Mongabay (Dec 2022) places PT Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park (IWIP) in Weda / Lelilef Sawai, Kabupaten Halmahera Tengah. KPPIP lists 'Kawasan Industri Weda Bay' (Maluku Utara) as a PSN, giving the province only.

regions_considered_not_used.reason: Konawe (Morosi smelters) is widely reported, but no source was retrieved in this sprint. Not modeled until sourced.
Halmahera Selatan (Pulau Obi processing) is widely reported, but no source was retrieved in this sprint. Not modeled.
Morowali Utara. No source retrieved tying it to the documented estates.

Halmahera Utara/Timur host nickel mining concessions (Mongabay cites a 39,040 ha Antam concession in Halmahera Timur), but the case concerns processing estates. Mining-only areas are deliberately not given industrial effects.

real_facts.fact: ESDM announced that nickel ore below 1.7% grade may no longer be exported from 1 January 2020, with a four-month transition. The stated rationale: proven reserves of 698 million tonnes could supply domestic refineries for only about 7.3 years. ESDM reported 11 nickel smelters built and 25 under construction.
real_facts.quote: Terhitung mulai 1 Januari 2020 bijih nikel dengan kadar di bawah 1,7% tidak lagi diperbolehkan untuk dieskpor.

real_facts.fact: The ban was later referenced as set by Peraturan Menteri ESDM 11/2019.
real_facts.note: At the time of the release the regulation was still being processed at Kemenkumham. The regulation number comes from later ESDM material and secondary legal reporting (hukumonline).

real_facts.fact: The EU requested WTO consultations on 22 November 2019 (DS592). The panel report, circulated 30 November 2022, found Indonesia's export prohibition and domestic processing requirements inconsistent with GATT Article XI:1. Indonesia notified an appeal on 8 December 2022, and the report is under appeal.
real_facts.quote: the Panel held that they were inconsistent with Article XI:1 of the GATT 1994

real_facts.fact: Perpres 112/2022 bans new coal power plants except, among others, plants integrated with industry built to add value to natural resources (ESDM cites smelters). These must cut GHG emissions by at least 35% within 10 years versus the 2021 PLTU average and operate at most until 2050.
BPS reported 2022 economic growth of 22.94% for Maluku Utara and 15.17% for Sulawesi Tengah, the two highest in the Sulawesi–Maluku–Papua region.
real_facts.note: Province level only. Attributing the growth to nickel processing comes from secondary sources (Bank Indonesia/academic summaries seen in search) and is not asserted in game text beyond 'industri pengolahan'.

real_facts.fact: President Joko Widodo said nickel raw-material exports earned about US$2.1 billion a year before 2020 and, after downstreaming and industrialisation, US$33.8 billion (about Rp32 trillion to Rp510 trillion). He also said jobs and tax, royalty and non-tax revenues now arise domestically.
real_facts.note: An official claim. The year of the US$33.8 billion figure is not stated, and product coverage (ore vs all nickel-derived products) is not defined in the article.

real_facts.fact: Kemenperin reported the Morowali estate at 2,000 ha, with planned investment of US$6 billion and a projected 26,000 direct and 80,000 indirect jobs, producing stainless steel, nickel pig iron and ferronickel.
real_facts.note: Projections stated in 2017, not measured employment.

real_facts.fact: A furnace explosion at the PT ITSS smelter inside the IMIP estate in Kabupaten Morowali on 24 December 2023 initially killed 13 workers. Kemnaker sent labour inspectors on 25 December. In February 2024 Polda Sulawesi Tengah reported 20 deaths and named two company officials as suspects.
real_facts.note: Reported tolls differ by date (13 → 18 → 20). The most recent figure attributed to the police is used.

real_facts.fact: Mongabay reported that Halmahera Tengah, where IWIP is located, lost about 14,876 ha of tree cover between 2001 and 2020 (Auriga Nusantara data). Weda Tengah had the largest share, and residents attribute recurring floods since 2020 to upstream clearing.
real_facts.note: Journalism citing NGO satellite analysis. The causal link between clearing and floods is residents' attribution, not an official finding.

trigger: Policy review after the WTO panel ruling (2022), the Perpres 112/2022 captive-coal exemption, and the fatal IMIP explosion (Dec 2023)
root_causes_note: Industrial-policy rationale (value added, reserves) is stated by ESDM and the President. Environmental and social concerns are documented as reported concerns and the accident as fact. The game does not assert causes beyond these sources.

fact_vs_simulation_notes: The export ban, the WTO ruling, the Perpres 112/2022 exemption, BPS growth figures, the presidential export claim (labeled as a claim) and the fatal explosion are real. The Halmahera Tengah forest loss is reported by journalism citing NGO data. The President's options and every consequence are SIMULATED. The game does not claim what actually happened after early 2024.
